crossRefs.note: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry…
Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves…
who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance…
He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the…
“So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to Yahweh’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy…
But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd…
Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

translations.web: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
translations.bsb: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.
translations.kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
translations.asv: which is an earnest of our inheritance, unto the redemption of Gods' own possession, unto the praise of his glory.
